evals.prompt: The plan is approved at docs/plans/2026-02-11-reporting/index.md. Please start implementing it.
evals.expected_output: Validates the plan index and task files, confirms approval, creates or enters a worktree, presents the dependency-ordered execution plan, then implements one task at a time, running each task's verification before recording a truthful ## Status with evidence. Ends by asking whether to hand off to review-and-pr without committing or pushing.

Reads the single task file, stays within its files/areas and acceptance criteria, runs its verification, records complete or blocked truthfully in the task file, and reports the result. Does not touch other tasks, commit, or open a PR.
